intent_record.intent_summary: Reject rxrpc keys with ticket lengths exceeding the maximum allowed limit to prevent potential buffer overflows.
intent_record.what: Added a boundary check on v1->ticket_length against AFSTOKEN_RK_TIX_MAX, setting ret to -EKEYREJECTED and jumping to error if the limit is exceeded.
intent_record.how: Prevents the kernel from processing rxrpc keys with excessively large ticket lengths, avoiding potential buffer overflows or out-of-bounds memory access during payload parsing.

candidates.rationale: The code calculates plen using v1->ticket_length without validating that v1->ticket_length is within the AFSTOKEN_RK_TIX_MAX limit, leading to an excessively large ticket length being accepted.
